fields.description: Order within In Review. Ascending. Gaps are allowed; duplicates are not.
fields.label: Sequence

fields.description: Display only. Nothing in the engine reads this to decide anything; stages are identified by row, ordered by sequence.
fields.label: Stage Label

fields.description: The Frappe role an approver must hold. Routing resolves against roles, never capabilities.
fields.label: Required Role

fields.description: nearest_ancestor: walk up from the document's Geo Node and stop at the first node where anybody holds the role. at_level: resolve at a named Geo Level, whatever is nearer. fixed_node: resolve at one named node, wherever the document sits.
fields.label: Resolution Rule

fields.description: Which level the decision belongs to, by policy. Per society, and never an assumed depth or label.
fields.label: Geo Level

fields.description: The one node this stage always resolves at: a national desk, a headquarters unit.
fields.label: Fixed Geo Node

fields.description: How many of the resolved approvers must act. single and any_of advance on the first decision; all_of waits for every resolved approver.
fields.label: Completion Rule

fields.description: Whether this stage may terminate the application, or only endorse it onward. At least one stage of a workflow must be able to reject.
fields.label: Can Reject

fields.description: Skipped when nobody resolves. A stage that is not optional and resolves nobody blocks and escalates; it never silently passes.
fields.label: Is Optional

fields.description: Days the resolved approver has before this stage is breached. Every stage has a clock, because an application rotting in an absent approver's queue is the failure mode this exists to catch.
fields.label: SLA Days

fields.description: escalate_up: route to the nearest holder above, never to whoever is already late. notify_only: remind, do not re-route. none: an explicit society choice to let it sit.
fields.label: On SLA Breach
